newsitem.title: USA: Artra Group unit completes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Artra Group unit completes acquisition.

text.p: Artra Group Inc said Monday its Bagcraft Corp of America unit completed the purchase of AB Specialty Holding Co from Stone Container Corp.
In mid-December, Artra completed the acquisition of the Alfred J. Bleyer Bag Division from the Fonda Group.

"Together, those two niche acquisitions will add approximately 10 percent to Bagcraft's annual sales base and have (a) positive effect on earnings," Mark Santacrose, Bagcraft president, said in a statement.
Bagcraft, with annual sales of about $130 million, makes flexible packaging.
